PullRequest.Title: sessions: remove unused mobile gesture helpers
PullRequest.Body:
<!-- Thank you for submitting a Pull Request. Please:
* Read our Pull Request guidelines:
  https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/How-to-Contribute#pull-requests
* Associate an issue with the Pull Request.
* Ensure that the code is up-to-date with the `main` branch.

Removes three Agents window phone gesture helpers that have never had a caller. There is no behavior change.

- **`installLongPress`** (`src/vs/sessions/browser/parts/mobile/longPress.ts`): touch long-press detection with a movement threshold and haptic feedback.
- **`installMobileEdgeSwipeToOpenSidebar`** (`src/vs/sessions/browser/parts/mobile/mobileEdgeSwipe.ts`): left-edge swipe to open the phone sidebar.
- **`installPulldownDismiss`** (`src/vs/sessions/browser/parts/mobile/contributions/mobilePulldownDismiss.ts`): pull-down-to-dismiss for full-screen overlays.

#318647 added all three as shared "infra primitives" for later mobile PRs, but none of those PRs imported them. The phone UI shipped with other implementations. For example, context menus, including those for long-pressed session rows, are shown as bottom sheets by `mobileContextMenuService.ts`.

Evidence that they were dead:

- A repository-wide search for the three function names, `IInstallLongPressOptions` and the three module names finds nothing outside the deleted files. That includes `build/next/mobilePolicy.json`, tests and the Agents window specs.
- `git log -S` for each function name, in `src/vs/sessions` and `src/vs/workbench`, finds only #318647. The exception is `installLongPress`, which also shows #320445 adding a mention to the docs and #331684 removing it.
- None of the three files had tests.

What stays, because other code still uses it:

- The other primitives from #318647: `mobilePickerSheet`, `mobileVisualViewport` and the `--vscode-keyboard-height` variable.
- `isPhoneLayout` from `vs/workbench/browser/parts/sessions/mobileLayout.ts`, which `longPress.ts` imported and many other phone layout files use.

Validation:

- `pnpm run typecheck-client`: passed.
- An import-graph reachability check over `src/vs`, run after the deletion, shows no other file becoming unreachable.

Scenarios.Scenario: Agents window startup and mobile contribution registration
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Startup loads registered contributions and services. None of the three deleted modules has an import or registration reference in the repository, and their module-level code only defines constants and exported functions; installation work required explicit calls.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One startup per window; zero reachable installations of the deleted helpers before and after the PR.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No deleted-helper work is scheduled, serially or concurrently. Existing mobile service registration is unchanged.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is added, removed, or invalidated. Cold and warm startup retain the same reachable module graph for these helpers.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: inspected every deleted line, searched repository-wide for exported symbols and module names, and inspected the mobile contribution registrations and build policy.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Static reference searches cannot exclude consumers outside the reviewed repository; there is no evidence of such consumers on the application path.
Scenarios.Verdict: No regression and no demonstrated runtime performance fix: the diff removes unreachable definitions, not startup work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Long-pressing a phone session row to display a context menu
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing MobileContextMenuService resolves actions and opens showMobilePickerSheet. It does not import or call installLongPress. User-selected action execution occurs after sheet completion and is unchanged.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Menu construction scales with the resolved action tree, not the total number of session rows. The deleted helper has zero call sites.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: MobileContextMenuService._showing suppresses overlapping menus. Browser event handling remains on the existing UI thread; deletion introduces no work or fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No gesture or menu cache changes. The same action-to-sheet construction occurs on both cold and repeated openings.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: repository-wide searches found no references to installLongPress, IInstallLongPressOptions, or its module; inspected the existing context-menu implementation and shared sheet shell.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Actual menu sizes and action execution costs were not measured; neither changes through this deletion.
Scenarios.Verdict: No added CPU work, listeners, timers, retained objects, or expensive boundary calls. The removed click-suppression and timer cleanup were owned only by an unused installer.

Scenarios.Scenario: Opening the sidebar on a phone viewport
Scenarios.CriticalPath: No live sidebar-opening path reaches installMobileEdgeSwipeToOpenSidebar. Its pointer listeners, geometry read, and openSidebar callback were all installed only inside the unused exported function.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Pointer-event frequency would control the helper's work if installed, but actual installation and callback cardinality are zero before and after the diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No deleted gesture listeners execute. The mobile layout contribution uses the existing MobileLayoutController independently of the removed module.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The deleted helper has no cache, and no existing layout cache or state lifecycle changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: inspected the complete deleted implementation, searched its symbol and module name repository-wide, and inspected the mobile layout contribution and controller.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: No gesture timing measurements were needed to establish that no reachable helper work is changed.
Scenarios.Verdict: Deleting an unused listener installer does not remove live throttling or cleanup and does not increase sidebar layout or input work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Displaying and dismissing mobile overlays and bottom sheets
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The removed installPulldownDismiss has no callers. The existing shared bottom-sheet shell independently handles backdrop, Done, Escape, navigation, viewport adjustment, and disposal; its close path disposes listeners immediately and removes DOM after its existing 180 ms timer.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Existing shell work scales with active sheets and their contents. The deleted pull-down helper contributes zero installations, pointer updates, transition callbacks, or timers before and after the diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Existing sheet input and DOM updates run on the browser UI thread. Close is guarded against repeat execution; deletion does not change animation or cleanup scheduling.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The existing per-window sheet stack and its deletion on final close are unchanged. No cold/warm or negative-cache behavior is affected.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: inspected the entire deletion, found no repository symbol/module references, and inspected the shared mobile sheet shell's dismissal and resource ownership.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Runtime rendering duration and overlay prevalence were not measured. Neither determines PR causality because the removed function is unreachable.
Scenarios.Verdict: No regression: no live cleanup is removed, no resources gain a longer lifetime, and no new subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, network, or serialization path is introduced.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance-review pass across all three changed files and all diff pages. These are deletion-only changes to unreferenced helper installers with no module-level registrations or meaningful side effects. Checked references, mobile service and layout registrations, build policy, and existing sheet ownership. No high-confidence performance regressions or concrete runtime regression fixes found. Static review only.
